qaFindings.statement: R0.1B D4/D5 remediation is implemented generically: declaration-level chained transforms are captured and later separate mutation statements are excluded. systemRecords and businessObjectRecords retain source-declared description fields while later-derived domainIds remain excluded.
R0.1B D6 is implemented: state is explicitly classified RUNTIME_UI_STATE, excluded from the canonical semantic payload and retained as auditable exclusion evidence.
The divergence detector no longer treats heterogeneous collections sharing an id as the same logical entity; corrected divergence count is zero and collisions remain informational evidence.

Producer/tool lineage was corrected during QA remediation: corrected candidates identify stage R0.1A-R and extractor 1.1.0 while historical R0.1A evidence remains immutable at stage R0.1A / extractor 1.0.0.

The historical R0.1A test contains four assertions superseded by governed R0.1A-R classification/version rules. The historical test remains byte-identical evidence and is not reused as the current certification oracle.

supersession.treatment: R0.1A remains immutable historical certified evidence but is not eligible for canonical promotion. R0.1A-R is the corrected candidate for R0.1B final authority closure.
